svg.text: Release, verify and close the practice case
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Same device page, VMware console and private client
Use Release from isolation when the test is complete, review the action status and verify
connectivity returns. If release fails, keep using the documented console/support recovery path
Re-test DNS/domain trust where appropriate, the help desk health check and current agent
reporting. Containment is not successful recovery until required services work again.
Resolve/classify the known test using its actual evidence, noting that it was an authorized
exercise. Record lessons and any missing control before closing the case.
Check: The device and its required application recover and the case contains a real evidence
